sloka: राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञातो मातलिः शक्रसारथिः ।दिव्यं तं रथमास्थाय दिवमेवारुरोह सः ।। ६.११५.५ ।।
transliteration: rāghaveṇābhyanujñāto mātaliḥ śakrasārathiḥ ।divyaṁ taṁ rathamāsthāya divamevāruroha saḥ ।। 6.115.5 ।।

translations.english: Matali, charioteer of Indra too taking Raghava's permission went to heaven in that wonderful chariot.
